\begin{example} \end{example}[Wave equation from the heat equation, via Laplace transform] ↗ def:laplace-transform ↗ thm:wave-equation-odd-dimensions-solution 1. ch4:4.3.2-ex-2\group Laplace Transform

For odd $n$, extend the zero-velocity wave solution evenly to negative time and set \[ v(x,t)=(4\pi t)^{-1/2}\int _\R e^{-s^2/(4t)}u(x,s)\, ds. \] Then $v_t-\Delta v=0$, $v(\cdot ,0)=g$. Comparing its heat-kernel formula and integrating by parts gives, for $n=2k+1$, \[ u(x,t)=\frac1{\gamma _n}\frac\partial {\partial t} \left(\frac1t\frac\partial {\partial t}\right)^{(n-3)/2} \left(t^{n-2}\int _{\partial B(x,t)}g\, dS\right), \] where $\gamma _n=(n-2)(n-4)\cdots 3$. The normalization uses the Gamma-function recursion from \cite{Rudin1976}. \end{example}
